Build your own extension app: https://datlag.dev/projects/mimasu/building

## Content not loading

Sometimes the services might block your connection.  
This release got new interactions to unblock your connection.

How to:
- Open Mimasu
- Go to your Profile
- Open the Extension
- Follow the steps inside the app

## Burning Series

The previous release might return the wrong season for the linked Burning Series data.

## Linking

AniWorld and SerienStream got an additional search AI to find and link series that could not be found previously. (#107)

name: 10.0.0 - Mimasu Extension
body:
Finally we reached a new release!

## Installation

Download the Extension App down below and install it as usual.

Download the Main App here: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.datlag.mimasu  
Install it as usual and start using it.

## Usage

After installing both apps, simply start the Mimasu App and search for you favorite series.  
If everything is setup both apps are doing everything automatically.

### Series - Episode Icon Types

If a series is available it will show icons on the episode preview images.

⚠️ Sometimes it takes a few seconds or you have to scroll up and down to refresh it.

- Play Arrow: Episode can be watched
- Warning: Episode cant be watched

## Supported Services

This repository will face a rename soon, as it is no longer Burning Series only!

- Burning Series
- SerienStream
- AniWorld

Have fun :)

name: 📑 5.2.0 - Connectivity and UX
body:
This release fixes bugs, crashes and improves the user experience.

## 📱 Android

You can now open weblinks like https://bs.to directly in the app, that means if you google for **"[your series] on burning series"**, it can be opened in the app. This also includes some **fake-sites** to prevent scam.

Steps to enable that feature:

- Navigate to your **System Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Burning-Series**
- Under **Open as default**: enable supported links and check all you want to use.

Keep in mind that this setting can differ depending on your manufacturer and Android Version.

## 🖥️ Desktop and 📱 Android

- Fix multiple crashes and bugs
- Double click episodes to mark them as finished (#68)
- Click navigation tab (Home, Favorite, Search) again to go back if you opened a series in there. (#68)
- Added Watch button for next or pending episode or to switch to next season if you finished the season
- Support loading of content even if website can't be reached in your network.
  - Display hint if still not possible to load data

## 🌏 Browser

No changes to the browser extension were made, you can keep using [version 5.0.0](https://github.com/DatL4g/Burning-Series/releases/tag/v5.0.0)

name: 🏝️ 5.0.0 - Laugh Tale
body:
It's been a long ride, but we've finally reached the end of the road. Don't be disappointed, it's not the end of the journey 😉

## 📰 Bad news? You decide!

### Television

❌ The Android TV is no longer fully supported, it may work but we don't maintain it.

✅ ChromeCast is now available! Share your videos directly to the TV instead.

### Store

❌ The App won't be available on F-Droid anymore.

✅ This downside however has a lot of upsides, read more below...

## 🎨 Theming

It automatically applies colors depending on the series to create a more immersive experience.

Otherwise some other design stuff has changed a bit, however the user experience stays the same or has even improved!

## 🕒 Durability

Since it's no longer updated on F-Droid, it's possible to implement a lot more features.

The activated episodes will be stored across multiple databases, so even if one doesn't work, it falls back to other sources.

## 🍎 iOS Support?

Currently iOS is not supported.

However the project and it's dependencies got updated a lot, so it's theoretically possible to develop for iOS.

Maybe some community member wants to jump in, as I'm not an iOS developer, but most work is already done!

name: 📜 4.7.0 - Error Logging and IMPORTANT Bug fix
body:
This release adds error (and debug) logging and comes with **IMPORTANT** bug fixes.

## 🛑 BUG Fix

- Series not loading
- Unable to change season
- Unable to change language

If any of these bugs happend to you before and are still present:

1. Go to the search overview
2. Search for the series you wanna fix
3. Open it from the search overview
    - That may reset the season / language
    - Your watch progress should remain 

## 📜 Logging

This release features error and debug logging.
If the app crashes go to Settings and scroll down to the logging section.

Banner meanings:
- **Red**: Error, please provide it in your issue
- **Yellow**: Warning, something went wrong but nothing serious
- **Blue**: Information, looks like everything is okay

Depending on your issue I might request a specific logging option and the corresponding log.
